jobs.description:
What We’re Looking For

We need a manager who combines operational excellence with a love for music and culture. The ideal candidate has:

• Restaurant management experience – you know how to run a smooth, profitable operation.
• Hands-on service background
• A background in music or cultural studies – formal education or significant practical experience in music, arts, or event curation is a strong plus.
• Excellent language skills – fluent in English and Chinese (to communicate with our team, including chefs and staff). Danish is a big advantage, as it helps with local suppliers and daily interactions.
 
Your Responsibilities
As our Restaurant Manager, you will be the driving force behind our new concept. Your key tasks will include:

• Designing and implementing the music-restaurant concept – curating playlists, planning live or DJ events, and aligning the audio experience with our brand.
• Creating staff rotas – ensuring optimal coverage while respecting work-life balance.
• Leading service-quality training – coaching the team to deliver warm, professional, and consistent service.
• Working closely with the kitchen team – ensuring seamless coordination between front-of-house and back-of-house for a flawless end-to-end guest journey.
• Overseeing daily operations – from opening procedures to guest relations, inventory, and health & safety standards.
We offer:

• ·         Competitive salary
• ·         Opportunity for career development
• ·         Work in an exciting and dynamic environment
• ·         Training and support from our experienced team

Ready to Make Some Noise?

If you’re excited to lead a restaurant that sings – literally and figuratively – we’d love to hear from you.

Please send your CV and a brief cover letter (in English) explaining your experience in management, service, and music/culture toramencopenhagen@gmail.com.

To further strengthen our Operations & Supply Chain organization, we are looking for an experienced Head of Operational Excellence at Group level.

This high-impact role, reporting directly to the COO, offers a unique opportunity to design, build, and implement the Operational Excellence system from the start. You will operate within an international environment with multiple manufacturing sites.

In this initial phase, you will take the lead in developing and rolling out the foundation of our Operational Excellence framework, driving sustainable operational improvements throughout the organization.

Your mission

- In the first phase, your key responsibility will be to: - Design and establish the Group-wide Operational Excellence Production System
- Build the standards, tools and governance needed for sustainable implementation
- Create and roll out structured processes across Production, Logistics and Quality
- Set up performance management (KPI cascade, visual management, gap analysis)
- Develop and initiate the first wave of improvement projects and cost optimization pipeline
- Following this setup phase, you will: - Drive year-on-year efficiency improvements
- Scale and embed Lean & Six Sigma methodologies across all sites
- Act as a change leader, embedding mindset, behavior and capabilities

Your profile

- Master’s degree in engineering with strong analytical and statistical skills
- At least 3 years of leadership experience in a complex operations/manufacturing environment
- Strong track record in building and implementing Operational Excellence frameworks from the ground up
- Deep expertise in Lean / Six Sigma (Green/Black Belt preferred)
- Structured, hands-on and capable of turning concepts into execution
- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
- Willingness to travel across Europe (25–50%)
- Fluent in English and preferably German

Benefits

- **Work-life balance:** We offer flexible working hours in a hybrid work environment
- **Time off & flexibility:** With 30 days of vacation per year and flexible scheduling
- **Quick decision-making & autonomy:** You’ll benefit from quick decision-making and plenty of freedom to pursue your own ideas and creative solutions
- **Motivated team & international environment:** Work in a dedicated team with colleagues from different countries and cultures
- Individual management coaching: We support your personal and professional development through individual coaching
- **Exciting tasks:** Look forward to varied responsibilities in a sustainable and innovative company
- **Comprehensive benefits:** Enjoy advantages such as capital-forming benefits, TicketPlus, Hansefit and exclusive discounts

Your next step - get in touch!

We welcome your application, including details of your salary expectations and your earliest possible start date. For initial contact, please reach out to Roman Heizmann, Recruiting Manager.

jobs.occupation: Køkken souschef søges til burger restaurant i vækst
jobs.description:
Souschef søges til burgerrestaurant i vækst

Er du passioneret omkring mad, kvalitet og godt teamwork – og har du lyst til at være en vigtig del af en burgerrestaurant i rivende udvikling? Smash Burger Roskilde byder dig velkommen...

Vi søger en dygtig og engageret souschef, som vil være med til at sikre høj kvalitet, godt flow i køkkenet og et stærkt team.

Vi er en burgerrestaurant i Roskilde i rivende vækst, og derfor søger vi en person, der både kan tage ansvar i den daglige drift og samtidig har lyst til at udvikle sig sammen med os.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Som souschef bliver du en central del af køkkendriften. Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være:

• 
At sikre høj kvalitet og ensartethed i vores mad

• 
At lede og motivere køkkenteamet i dagligdagen

• 
At sikre god struktur og effektivitet under travle serviceperioder

• 
At hjælpe med oplæring af nye medarbejdere

• 
At sikre, at hygiejne, rengøring og egenkontrol er i orden

• 
At assistere køkkenchefen med den daglige planlægning og drift

• 
At tage ansvar for køkkenet, når køkkenchefen ikke er til stede

• 
At bidrage med idéer til udvikling af menu, arbejdsgange og køkkendrift

Vi forventer, at du

• 
Har erfaring fra et professionelt køkken – gerne som souschef, kok eller lignende

• 
Trives med højt tempo og mange bestillinger

• 
Kan bevare overblikket, når der er travlt

• 
Er kvalitetsbevidst og går op i detaljerne

• 
Er en naturlig leder, som kan skabe respekt og god energi omkring dig

• 
Er mødestabil, ansvarsbevidst og fleksibel

• 
Har lyst til at være en del af en virksomhed i vækst

• 
Har en positiv indstilling og bidrager til et godt arbejdsmiljø

Det vigtigste er dog ikke, at du kan det hele fra dag ét. Vi leder efter den rigtige person med den rigtige indstilling, som har lyst til at tage ansvar og udvikle sig sammen med restauranten.

Vi tilbyder

• 
En spændende stilling i en burgerrestaurant i vækst

• 
En central rolle i den daglige drift

• 
Mulighed for at udvikle dine ledelses- og køkkenfaglige kompetencer

• 
Et ungt og dynamisk arbejdsmiljø

• 
Gode kolleger og en uformel omgangstone

• 
Mulighed for at få indflydelse på restaurantens videre udvikling

• 
Konkurrencedygtig løn efter kvalifikationer

Lyder det som dig?

Så vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig!

Send din ansøgning og CV til info@smash-burger.dk og kontakt os på 28691238

Vi afholder samtaler løbende, så send gerne din ansøgning allerede i dag.

 Bliv en del af vores team – og vær med til at bygge noget stort op sammen med os!

ENGLISH:

Sous Chef Wanted for a Growing Burger Restaurant

Are you passionate about food, quality, and great teamwork – and would you like to play an important role in a rapidly growing burger restaurant? Smash Burger Roskilde welcomes you...

We are looking for a skilled and dedicated Sous Chef to help us maintain high quality, an efficient kitchen operation, and a strong team.

We are a rapidly growing burger restaurant in Roskilde, and we are therefore looking for someone who is ready to take responsibility for the daily operations while also being motivated to grow and develop together with us.

Your Responsibilities

As Sous Chef, you will play a central role in the daily kitchen operations. Your responsibilities will include:

• 
Ensuring high quality and consistency in all our food

• 
Leading and motivating the kitchen team on a daily basis

• 
Ensuring good structure and efficiency during busy service periods

• 
Assisting with the training and onboarding of new employees

• 
Ensuring that hygiene, cleaning, and food safety procedures are maintained

• 
Assisting the Head Chef with daily planning and kitchen operations

• 
Taking responsibility for the kitchen when the Head Chef is not present

• 
Contributing ideas for menu development, workflows, and kitchen operations

We Expect You To

• 
Have experience working in a professional kitchen – preferably as a Sous Chef, Chef, or in a similar position

• 
Thrive in a fast-paced environment with a high volume of orders

• 
Be able to stay calm and maintain an overview during busy periods

• 
Be quality-conscious and pay attention to detail

• 
Be a natural leader who can create respect and positive energy within the team

• 
Be reliable, responsible, and flexible

• 
Be motivated to become part of a growing business

• 
Have a positive attitude and contribute to a great working environment

Most importantly, you don't need to know everything from day one. We are looking for the right person with the right attitude – someone who is ready to take responsibility and grow together with the restaurant.

We Offer

• 
An exciting position in a growing burger restaurant

• 
A key role in the daily kitchen operations

• 
Opportunities to develop your leadership and culinary skills

• 
A young and dynamic working environment

• 
Great colleagues and an informal workplace culture

• 
The opportunity to influence the continued development of the restaurant

• 
Competitive salary based on qualifications and experience

Does This Sound Like You?

Then we would love to hear from you!

Send your application and CV to info@smash-burger.dk or contact us on +45 28 69 12 38.

We are conducting interviews on an ongoing basis, so don't hesitate to send your application today.

 Join our team – and be part of building something great together with us!

Are you looking for a fast-paced job with great colleagues, plenty of workshop banter, and a workday that flies by? Then we have the perfect opportunity for you!

We are currently looking for several motivated Tire Fitters for one of our clients in Randers, Horsens, Kolding and Sønderborg. You don't need previous experience – what matters most is that you're motivated, willing to work hard, and bring a positive attitude. We'll teach you the rest.

• It's a great way to earn extra money – whether you're a student or simply looking for more working hours.
• Many temporary assignments lead to permanent employment.
• You'll earn pension contributions and holiday pay while working with HumanizeR.
Does this sound like the right opportunity for you?

Send us your application today! We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis and will hire as soon as we've found the right candidates.

Want to gain hands-on experience within cyber security and compliance, in critical IT infrastructure?

Join our Infrastructure & Security team and get hands-on experience with vulnerability management, audits, access governance, security reporting, and compliance activities. You'll work alongside experienced specialists and help protect business-critical systems while building valuable real-world skills.

Nordic RCC – supporting security of supply and the green energy transition

The Nordic Regional Coordination Centre (RCC) provides critical services and insights to support the national Transmission System Operators (TSOs) in Finland, Norway, Sweden and Denmark — to ensure the efficient operation and use of the Nordic power system and high security of power supply at any time. Based in Copenhagen, Nordic RCC is one of six RCCs in Europe, equally owned by the Nordic region's four electricity TSOs: Fingrid, Statnet, Svenska Kraftnät, and Energinet.

As European power systems integrate and evolve to meet climate goals, Nordic RCC provides regional coordination, integrated services, regional insights and recommendations to the Nordic TSOs and their control centers, to support cross-border operational security 24/7.

You can read more about Nordic RCC and the services we deliver on our website https://nordic-rcc.net/ 

Right now, we are looking for a Student Assistant – Cyber Security & Compliance who likes to make a difference!

Job description:

We are looking for a Student Assistant to support the Infrastructure & Security team. The role will work closely with the Cyber Security and Compliance functions, helping maintain governance processes, security operations, reporting, and documentation while gaining practical experience within enterprise IT security and compliance. The position supports activities within vulnerability management, access governance, audits, and security reporting.

Responsibilities:

Security Operations Support

• 
Support vulnerability management activities and follow up on remediation actions.

• 
Assist with endpoint compliance reviews and Intune-related administrative activities.

• 
Support vulnerability management activities and follow up on remediation actions.

• 
Coordinate follow-up with system owners and suppliers regarding security findings.

Compliance & Audit Support

• 
Collect, organize, and maintain audit evidence.

• 
Support preparation for internal and external audits.

• 
Maintain compliance documentation and evidence repositories.

• 
Track audit findings and remediation activities.

Access Management & Governance

• 
Assist with periodic access reviews.

• 
Track completion of access review activities.

• 
Help maintain governance processes and security controls documentation.

Documentation & Process Management

• 
Update security procedures, standards, and runbooks.

• 
Maintain SharePoint-based documentation repositories.

• 
Ensure documents are reviewed and updated according to governance requirements.

Requirements:

• 
Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's degree within IT, Cyber Security, Information Security, Computer Science, or a related field.

• 
Structured and detail-oriented approach to work.

• 
Strong analytical and documentation skills.

• 
Experience with Microsoft 365, Excel, and SharePoint is an advantage.

• 
Interest in cyber security, governance, risk, and compliance.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet all the listed requirements.

What we offer

You will be joining a company of competent, diverse, and enthusiastic colleagues. We are currently 25 nationalities with over 30% women (striving to improve this balance) and all ages.

Your daily workplace will be in our newly furnished office premises in Copenhagen Towers, Ørestad. We offer workplace flexibility to ensure a healthy work-life balance, including the possibility to work from home some of the time. 

Our values of fellowship, curiosity, respect, and transparency have been defined by all employees. They identify how we behave and shape the way we work together, and we expect you to see yourself in them.

Note:

The position is conditioned upon a satisfactory background check as well as a national security clearance, both of which will be facilitated by Nordic RCC. You can read more on security clearance here. Please also note that the process includes that any spouse, registered partner, cohabitant, steady partner, co-resident, child over 18 living at home and parent with the same address as the candidate must also consent to be examined.

Application deadline and contact information

Please apply online as soon as possible (in English) and no later than 30/09/2026. We may conduct interviews on a continuous basis.

A cover letter is not required, but we kindly ask you to include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are interested in the position. Applications are only accepted through our online recruitment system.

To ensure a fair and unbiased recruitment process, we kindly request that you do not include a photograph in your CV or any other materials.

If you have any questions, please contact Patrick Frømming, Manager, Infrastructure & Security (PFN@nordic-rcc.net).

Bang's VVS is looking for one qualified and experienced plumber / plumbing installer to join our team on Lolland, Denmark.

You'll need to already have the legal right to work in Denmark, for example EU/EEA or Swiss citizenship, or a valid Danish work and residence permit. Unfortunately, we're not able to offer visa or work permit sponsorship for this role.

Your role

You will carry out varied plumbing work for private customers, businesses, industry and construction projects on Lolland.

We are looking for someone who:

• Is a qualified plumber with relevant vocational training

• Has practical experience as a plumber

• Can work independently and deliver high-quality work

• Is service-minded and comfortable working with customers

• Can communicate in English

• Has a category B driving licence

• Is willing to relocate to Lolland and make the area your place of residence

What we offer

• Gross hourly wage: DKK 180-220, depending on qualifications and experience

• Candidates with several years of relevant experience can expect a salary at the higher end of the range

• Permanent employment, 37 hours per week, Monday to Friday

• Pension scheme

• 5 weeks of vacation

• Flexible benefits account for extra vacation, salary or pension

• Company vehicle

• Assistance with finding suitable accommodation

About Bang's VVS

Bang's VVS is an authorised Danish plumbing and sheet metal company established in 2016.

The company works with private customers, businesses, industry, agriculture and construction projects and handles both small and large projects. Bang's VVS places strong emphasis on quality workmanship, good customer service and energy-efficient solutions.

You will join an informal workplace with good colleagues, a high degree of independence and a strong focus on quality workmanship.

Recruitment Process

The first interview can be conducted online if required. Selected candidates may be invited to visit the workplace before a final employment agreement is made.

We review applications on an ongoing basis and encourage candidates to apply as soon as possible.

How to apply

Send your application to:

rekruttering@lolland.dk

Please write "Bang's VVS" in the subject line.

Martin Hansen
Business Consultant and EURES adviser, Lolland Municipality
Phone: +45 21 47 73 43
Email: maha@lolland.dk

We kindly ask recruitment agencies and intermediaries to refrain from contacting us regarding this position. Applications will only be considered if submitted directly by candidates.

About Lolland and Relocation Support

Lolland is located in the southern part of Denmark, offering a peaceful lifestyle with easy access to nature, beaches, and open countryside. The region combines affordable housing, short commuting distances, and a strong sense of community.

The region is currently experiencing significant development, partly due to the Femern Belt Fixed Link, one of Europe's largest infrastructure projects, which will create a direct road and rail connection between Denmark and Germany.

As an international employee, you will have access to Lolland Municipality's Newcomers Service, which offers free support with relocation, registration, housing guidance, partner job support, and settling into life in Denmark.

For more information about Lolland and contact details, visit newcomers.lolland.dk
More information about living and working in Denmark can be found at www.workindenmark.dk

jobs.occupation: Cleaning Assistants, Private Homes – Greater Copenhagen
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy making a difference in people's homes – and finishing the day's last visit with a clear conscience and a great result behind you?

RengøringsAgenterne ApS is looking for several skilled cleaning assistants for our private home cleaning department. You will be out cleaning private homes for our regular customers across Greater Copenhagen – and you will join a team where quality, trust and a good atmosphere come first.

RengøringsAgenterne is a Nordic Swan Ecolabel certified cleaning and property services company based in Kastrup. We have more than 200 employees, run a 100% electric vehicle fleet, and won the Børsen Gazelle award in both 2023 and 2024.

About the job

As a cleaning assistant in private home cleaning, you drive out to our private customers and make sure their homes are sparkling when you leave. You will have regular customers, so you get to know the homes and the customers' wishes – and they get to know you.

Your tasks include:

•      Regular, recurring cleaning of private homes – vacuuming, floor washing, wiping surfaces, bathrooms and kitchens

•      Occasional extra jobs such as deep cleaning and move-out cleaning

•      Driving between customers during the day

•      Everyday dialogue with customers about wishes and arrangements

You work independently in the homes, but you are never on your own – your inspector and the office team are always just a phone call away.

We expect that you

•      Are thorough, reliable in attendance and take pride in a tidy result – quality is what we live on

•      Are trustworthy, as you work in people's private homes and often hold a key to the property

•      Are friendly and service-minded when meeting customers

•      Can make yourself understood in Danish or English

•      Can present a clean criminal record certificate (straffeattest)

•      Enjoy physical work at a good pace

•      Hold a category B driving licence, as you drive between customers during the day

Cleaning experience is an advantage, but not a requirement – we will train you in our methods and Nordic Swan Ecolabel certified products.

We offer

•      A permanent full-time position with a steady monthly income you can count on

•      Working hours on weekdays during the daytime – no evening or weekend work

•      Thorough training, great colleagues and a dedicated inspector you can always turn to

•      Regular customers and routes, so you know your day

•      Work clothing and professional, Nordic Swan Ecolabel certified products and equipment

•      A growing workplace with proper employment terms and green values – our entire vehicle fleet is electric

Practical information

•      Work area: Private homes across Greater Copenhagen – based out of Fuglebækvej 3D, 2770 Kastrup

•      Working hours: Full-time, weekdays during the daytime

•      Start date: As soon as possible, or by agreement

How to apply

Send your application and CV via Jobnet or to privat@ren-agenterne.dk. We hold interviews on an ongoing basis and will hire as soon as we find the right candidates – so send your application today.

If you have any questions about the position, feel free to write to us at privat@ren-agenterne.dk.

We look forward to hearing from you!

•

•

•
